is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates insecticide-treated nets against Anopheles gambiae and Culex quinquefasciatus (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for kdr (page 5, Results, Genotype frequencies) and Ace-1 G119S (page 4, Methods, DNA diagnostic test; page 6, Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 on page 6 provides genotype counts (Ace-1R/Ace-1R, Ace-1R/Ace-1S, Ace-1S/Ace-1S) for Anopheles gambiae.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from experimental huts at a field site of the Institut Pierre Richet in Yaokoffikro, Bouaké, Côte d'Ivoire (page 2, Materials and methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial conducted by the authors (page 1, Abstract).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted at a field site in Yaokoffikro, Bouaké, Côte d'Ivoire (page 2, Materials and methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The trial ran for 33 nights over 6 weeks starting from 15 August 2002 (page 3, Sleepers and mosquito collections).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific experimental hut trial conducted in 2002.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in Table 2 on page 6.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of chlorpyrifos-methyl and lambdacyhalothrin treated nets in experimental huts in Côte d'Ivoire. It genotyped Anopheles gambiae for kdr and Ace-1 G119S mutations and assessed the impact of these genotypes on survival in the experimental huts.
